failureStage: manual-assisted authentication setup; before OTP verification, cart Add and customer-form assertions
derivation: The live Cypress route records show a later OTP-start request after the one permitted start. The unchanged checkout guard denies a second start when otpStartCount is already one. This reason is derived from those records and the guard source, not retroactively inserted into the original diagnostics.
limitations: HTTP 200 does not establish SMS provider acceptance or handset delivery.
Errored route records can include browser network retries and are not a count of user clicks or delivered messages.
The guard uses req.destroy(); a Firefox network error during denied resend is consistent with that action, but the exact NS error code was not independently captured.
Neither an application SMS defect nor an OTP verification defect is confirmed.
The failed run cannot resume by entering a code; a future visible run needs a working authorized delivery channel and another manual handoff.
privacy: Only sanitized outcomes and booleans; no phone, OTP, session body, cookies, tokens or personal screenshots. Original result and progress files remain unchanged.
